title: Pairwise universal overlap restrictions
statement: Given h:Z→X, a universe-small open cover C of Z, and universal first order thickenings i_k:C_k→Z'_k over X with structure maps h'_k [def-weil-pbc-universal-first-order-thickening], there are schemes V(k,l), open immersions f(k,l):V(k,l)→Z'_k and maps s(k,l):C_k ×_Z C_l→V(k,l) [def-pc-fibre-product]. Each f(k,k) is an isomorphism. Each s(k,l) with structure map f(k,l) followed by h'_k is a universal first order thickening of the source pullback with structure map its first projection followed by C.f k and h. The composite s(k,l) followed by f(k,l) equals the first projection followed by i_k. For each z in C_k, i_k(z) belongs to the image of f(k,l) exactly when C.f k(z) belongs to the image of C.f l. Schemes and open immersions have the conventions of [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and [def-weil-open-immersion].

proof.text: Apply the open-pieces theorem to W=(C.f k) inverse image of the open image of C.f l and the whole base. It gives W prime, the inverse-image identity, and a universal restricted thickening. Enlarge its base from the whole open of X to X, obtaining structure map W prime inclusion followed by h prime k.

proof.text: Identify the source pullback with W by Mathlib IsOpenImmersion.range_pullbackFst and isoOfRangeEq. Transport the universal property along this isomorphism: precompose the source immersion and structure map; the lifting property follows by composing the test source map with the isomorphism. Its square-zero kernel is unchanged by Scheme.Hom.ker_comp_of_isIso. The isoOfRangeEq factorization gives s followed by f.

proof.text: Choose these uniquely determined open restrictions for every pair. For a diagonal pair W is the whole chart since each point maps into the image of its own cover map; uniqueness of the inverse-image open makes W prime the whole thickened chart. Its inclusion is Scheme.topIso.hom. The pointwise range condition is the inverse-image equality and Scheme.Opens.range_ι.

lean.statement:
theorem universalFirstOrderThickening_pairwiseOverlaps
    {Z X : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ X) (C : Z.OpenCover.{u})
    (Z' : C.I₀ → Scheme.{u}) (i : ∀ k, C.X k ⟶ Z' k)
    (h' : ∀ k, Z' k ⟶ X)
    (H : ∀ k, IsUniversalFirstOrderThickening (C.f k ≫ h) (i k) (h' k)) :
    ∃ (V : C.I₀ × C.I₀ → Scheme.{u}) (f : ∀ k l, V (k, l) ⟶ Z' k)
      (s : ∀ k l, pullback (C.f k) (C.f l) ⟶ V (k, l)),
      (∀ k l, IsOpenImmersion (f k l)) ∧
      (∀ k, IsIso (f k k)) ∧
      (∀ k l, IsUniversalFirstOrderThickening
        (pullback.fst (C.f k) (C.f l) ≫ C.f k ≫ h) (s k l) (f k l ≫ h' k)) ∧
      (∀ k l, s k l ≫ f k l = pullback.fst _ _ ≫ i k) ∧
      ∀ k l (z : C.X k),
        i k z ∈ Set.range (f k l) ↔ C.f k z ∈ Set.range (C.f l)
